profile.campus: True North Data campus, Loudoun County, VA (Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, PIN 194103673000, approved Jan 2018)
profile.reading: This building sits at 42254 Thunderball Drive in Leesburg, Virginia, part of a data center campus that Loudoun County own zoning and permitting records identify by the project name True North Data. Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, filed under that project name, rezoned roughly 105 acres to Planned Development-Office Park specifically to allow data center uses, and was approved January 18, 2018. The underlying parcel, county PIN 194103673000, covering roughly 97 acres, is recorded under a condominium-regime plat named True North Land Condo, a legal structure commonly used to subdivide one large hyperscale campus parcel into separately titled buildings, consistent with the six separate addresses and building records that make up this cluster. A 2019 grading permit for a project called True North 2 described three data center buildings with utilities, and a 2023 stormwater permit for True North Data Phase 2A covered a further 16.5 acres of disturbed area, indicating a phased expansion. Four tenant fit-up zoning permits were issued across April and May 2025, suggesting the campus was still being built out in phases as recently as that year. No document reviewed this session, however, gives a total megawatt capacity, final building count, or total square footage for the completed campus, and the identity of the corporate entity that actually filed the original 2017 rezoning application is not exposed in the county public zoning-case layer, so True North Data Solutions, the name this record carries as operator, could not be independently confirmed as a registered company through the Virginia State Corporation Commission this session. Loudoun County is widely described as the largest data center market in the world by capacity, and Leesburg location within it, near the eastern edge of the county fiber and power-dense corridor, is consistent with why a developer would pursue a multi-building campus of this scale here specifically.

reading.body:
The True North Data campus in Leesburg occupies roughly 97 acres rezoned for data center use by Loudoun County in January 2018. County permitting records from 2019 through 2025 document phased construction of multiple buildings across the site, with the most recent activity in April and May 2025 showing tenant fit-up work still underway. No megawatt capacity figure has been published for this campus, so its scale relative to other facilities cannot be determined from operator disclosures.

Loudoun County is the largest data center market in the world by capacity, and this Leesburg site sits near the eastern edge of the county's fiber and power corridor where major hyperscale campuses cluster. Virginia has 326 mapped data center facilities but only 23 with published capacity figures totaling 1375.4 MW. This campus cannot be ranked within the state's deployed capacity until or unless an operator publishes a power specification.

The legal structure of the property, subdivided into separately titled buildings under a condominium regime, is typical of multi-building hyperscale campuses built in phases. The phasing evident in county permits through 2025 suggests the campus was still being completed during that year. The operator name True North Data Solutions does not appear as a registered entity in Virginia State Corporation Commission records searched this session, and the company's web domain redirects to a GoDaddy sale page, leaving the corporate identity behind the campus unclear from publicly available sources.
